title: See you at Directions EMEA 2026
text: I'm in Paris this week for Directions EMEA 2026 (27-29 October), the event for the Business Central partner community. Interested in IoT, PrintVis integrations or our AI agents for BC development? Get in touch.

title: New website is live!
text: Welcome to the new 1vision365.com: a fresh look, clearer product pages for IoT Link and the IoT-2-PrintVis Connector, and a closer look at how we build with agentic coding.

title: Meet the agent crew
text: Our daily development now runs on a crew of AI agents, with a person deciding what ships and merging it. Read how the work flows from report to release.

title: Moxa-2-PrintVis is now an adapter
text: The former Moxa-2-PrintVis app has been replaced by the IoT-2-PrintVis Connector, with one adapter for Moxa and one for ifm moneo.
